row:
Hi, my name is Hannah Baycroft, a freelance presenter and performer based in London, living my creative life with my former racehorse. While I work professionally in front of the camera, this channel is my creative space, a place to experiment, practise, and share my passion for storytelling and content production. Your support means a lot in the quest to build this channel so please subscribe. 

Collaborations & Enquiries
I’m always open to new projects, presenting opportunities, and creative collaborations so please do get in touch: 
Email: hannah.baycroft@googlemail.com

Performing credits: https://www.spotlight.com/1931-7869-9650

Let’s connect: 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hannahbaycroft/
Twitter/X: www.twitter.com/racingwithhanna
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@racingwithhanna

Subscribe & join me on this adventure!
